input.query: My claim was denied. What's wrong with it?

rationale: data/claims.json + data/benefits.json + data/providers.json show member, plan, a present covered benefit, and a resolvable servicing provider for CLM-1001 -- all four critical categories are satisfied, so investigate_claim must report COMPLETED even though no matching prior authorization exists in data/prior_authorizations.json for M-1001.

input.query: Why was my specialist visit claim denied?

rationale: data/benefits.json has no record for PLAN-BRONZE + SPECIALIST-VISIT, and data/providers.json has no record for PRV-9999 (CLM-1005's own servicing provider_id) -- two of the four critical categories are unresolved, so investigate_claim must report INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and suggest escalate_case as the next capability.
data/members.json maps M-1001 to PLAN-GOLD; data/benefits.json has BEN-GOLD-MRI-KNEE with covered=true. A present, covered benefit record means nothing is missing.

data/members.json maps M-1003 to PLAN-SILVER; data/benefits.json has BEN-SILVER-LAB-BASIC with covered=false. This is an AUTHORITATIVE, present benefit determination -- covered=false must be reported as COMPLETED, never as missing evidence.

data/members.json maps M-1005 to PLAN-BRONZE; data/benefits.json has NO record for PLAN-BRONZE + SPECIALIST-VISIT. The genuine absence of a rule must be reported as missing evidence, never inferred as covered or not covered.

data/prior_authorizations.json has no record with member_id=M-1001. An empty result is itself a complete, valid finding (never an assumed denial), so status stays COMPLETED with prior_authorization flagged as missing.

data/prior_authorizations.json has exactly two records for member_id=M-1002 + service_code=MRI-KNEE (PA-1501 EXPIRED, PA-2001 APPROVED) -- both must be preserved and returned, not collapsed to just the currently-applicable one.

input.reason: Critical structured evidence (benefit, servicing provider) is unresolved.

rationale: escalate_case only assembles a synthetic escalation package -- it never contacts an external system -- so external_system_contacted must always be false, and the missing_information passed in must be carried through unchanged for the human reviewer.
